claim: Hidden (invisible) switch sprites differ from visible ones in channel role or placement.
evidence: Two controlled contrasts, 115 hidden against 1,281 visible campaign switch sprites, reached nothing near the 0.65 discriminator floor (reports/blood-effects-switches.md, reports/blood-hidden-switch-placement.md, 2026-08-31).
use: Do not re-run the contrast on sprites; to learn how Blood presents a switch, read the XWALL faces.
instead: 57% of hidden and 59% of visible switch sprites sit in a logic closet no player enters; the mapper wires the sprite by channel and what the player pushes is an XWALL elsewhere. Study the pushed XWALLs, not switch sprites.
